workarounds.symptom: Toolbox deleteFile still returns 404 for DELETE /files with recursive=true
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(toolbox): register DELETE route without trailing slash. Target files: apps/daemon/pkg/toolbox/server.go, apps/daemon/pkg/toolbox/server_test.go. The toolbox server registered DELETE /files/ but not DELETE /files. The TypeScript SDK sends DELETE /files (no trailing slash) when deleting files with recursive=true, resulting in a 404. (Ref: https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/5037)

workarounds.symptom: CLI snapshot create with --context fails with "error checking bucket existence: Access Denied" after push-access ListBucket scoping (#4966)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): drop redundant BucketExists probes in minio client. Target files: apps/cli/pkg/minio/minio.go. `daytona snapshot create --context` fails with `error checking bucket existence: Access Denied` since #4966 scoped the `s3:ListBucket` grant in the push-access STS policy with a `StringLike` condition on `s3:prefix`. (Ref: https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/5014)

workarounds.symptom: bug(opencode-plugin): git sync silently fails on slim sandbox images — git not installed
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(opencode): make git sync work on slim sandboxes. Target files: libs/opencode-plugin/.opencode/plugin/daytona/git/sandbox-git-manager.ts, images/sandbox-slim/Dockerfile. - Add `git` to the slim sandbox image so OpenCode git sync works with the default slim sandbox. - Make sandbox git commands fail loudly on non-zero exit codes instead of logging command output as successful progress. - Include an actionable hint when git is missing from a sandbox. (Ref: https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/4952)

workarounds.symptom: SDK 0.175+ broken when bundled to CJS — createRequire(import.meta.url) shim returns stub
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(sdk-typescript): make ESM require shim survive esbuild→CJS rebundle. Target files: libs/sdk-typescript/runtime-tests/esbuild-cjs/package.json, libs/sdk-typescript/runtime-tests/esbuild-cjs/test.ts, libs/sdk-typescript/scripts/post-build.js. — SDK breaks at runtime when the ESM build is re-bundled to CJS (e.g. `esbuild --platform=node --format=cjs`). The post-build shim declared `const require = createRequire(import.meta.url)`, which shadows the host CJS `require` when a bundler flattens ESM→CJS. Since `import.meta.url`... (Ref: https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/4888)

workarounds.symptom: TypeScript SDK: getEnvVar() doesn't read process.env on Cloudflare Workers (SERVERLESS runtime)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(sdk-typescript): isolate per-Sandbox Configuration; support process.env on serverless. Target files: libs/sdk-typescript/src/Daytona.ts, libs/sdk-typescript/src/utils/Runtime.ts, libs/sdk-typescript/src/__tests__/Daytona.test.ts. Two independent SDK-TypeScript bug fixes: 1. **Per-`Sandbox` `Configuration` isolation** in `Daytona.list()` — each yielded `Sandbox` now receives its own `Configuration` instance, fixing a P1 raised by `cubic-dev-ai` on #4606. 2. **`process.env` on serverless runtimes** — `getEnvVar()` no lon... (Ref: https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/4858)

workarounds.symptom: @daytonaio/sdk v0.175.0: sandbox.fs.downloadFile fails with `require is not defined` in Next.js App Router
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(sdk-typescript): route stream module through dynamicImport in ESM downloadFile path. Target files: libs/sdk-typescript/runtime-tests/nextjs-external/app/api/download/route.ts, libs/sdk-typescript/runtime-tests/nextjs-external/app/api/sandboxes/route.ts, libs/sdk-typescript/runtime-tests/nextjs-external/next-env.d.ts. — `sandbox.fs.downloadFile()` throws `ReferenceError: require is not defined` when the SDK is externalized via Next.js `serverExternalPackages`. (Ref: https://github.com/daytonaio/daytona/pull/4773)
